summary: [standards, spec fidelity] The 17.2 evidence list is not the contract's list and one sentence under it is false. approaches/checker.md section 8 (identical in v1.2.1 and v1.3.1) has 19 obligations; the table has 8 rows. Missing with neither a row, an N/A reason nor a stated gap: remote effects of reads and refusals, commit atomicity (canon has tests: atip_planjcs_06, _07, _14), no /dev/tty prompt, conservative staging (exit 2 only before the work), reasons emitted only when registered, validators tested in isolation; streams and L0 paging are N/A and unsaid. The sentence 'canon has no remote reads' is wrong: canon.yaml routes session, run, event and handoff to postgres and the cold rung to s3, and query, tier age, purge and artifacts move reach them (PgTier, R2Tier); no test uses a fake backend and asserts no calls on a read or a refusal. Fix: one row per section 8 obligation naming its tests, or an N/A reason, or a stated gap (remote reads/refusals is a gap today); scenarios .11 and .13 say one row per obligation. Blast radius: atip.claiml2.11/.12 pass because OBLIGATIONS in atip_claiml2.rs is the same 8 words, so the list can be incomplete and green.
